# Cabinet — Template Tasks & Notes

## Template Info

- **New name:** Cabinet
- **ColorLib source:** Furn (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/furn/)
- **Preview URL:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/furn/
- **Category:** Furniture & Interior Design

## Design Notes

### Color Palette

- Brand/Primary: #fd8f5f (warm orange)
- Navy/Heading: #1f2b7b (deep blue)
- Background: #ffffff
- Text: #2a2a2a
- Warm accent: #f2e1d9 (peach)
- Border: #ececec

### Swatches

- Forest: #2f5d50
- Stone: #c9c3b8
- Tan: #b07a4e
- Oak: #c8a06a
- Cream: #efe6d8
- Charcoal: #3a3a3c
- Walnut: #6b4a2f
- Brass: #c9a227
- Linen: #e6ddd0
- Slate: #5a6472

### Typography

- Font: Poppins (Google Fonts)
- Headings: uppercase, weight 700
- Body: weight 400, line-height 1.6

### Layout

- Max-width: 1300px
- Border-radius: 0px (sharp corners throughout)
- Section padding: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem)
- Grid gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem)

### Component Structure

1. AnnouncementBar — rotating text carousel
2. Navbar — sticky, white bg, logo + nav links
3. Hero — full-width image with overlay content
4. PopularProducts — tabbed product grid
5. AboutSection — image-with-text, warm bg
6. RecommendedProducts — 4-column product grid
7. Newsletter — dark bg, email input
8. Footer — 3-column, dark bg, Component Dock link
